newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Orient to offer 100 mln B shares in May.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Orient to offer 100 mln B shares in May.

text.p: Beijing Orient Electronics (Group) Co Ltd will launch an offer of 100 million B shares in May and has named China Southern Securities as its lead underwriter, a company spokesman said on Friday.
A roadshow for the issue, which will include presentations in the United States and Japan, will be in March and April, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Nomura International (H.K.) Ltd and W.I. Carr (Far East) Ltd have been appointed international coordinators, he said.
The firm has yet to decide the pricing of the offer and whether it will list the shares in Shanghai or Shenzhen.
Beijing Orient, which makes television tubes and lamps, is among the 33 domestic enterprises newly selected by the Securities Commission of the State Council to list B shares.
If the issue goes through, Orient plans to use most of the share proceeds to import a production line designed to produce three million lamps annually, he said.

The company, whose 1996 lamp output was 2.38 million units, estimated a net profit of 120 million yuan for 1996 versus around 100 million yuan in 1995 and 88 million yuan a year earlier, the official said.
It has 260 million outstanding shares owned by founding institutions, he said.
